column1: # Original WritingDeck plots; MIT to the extent rights subsist; AI-assisted original drafting.
# stable_id|category|genres|premise

wd-p-0927|interdependence|realist,political|A conservation group restores a wetland by raising water levels. The change benefits wildlife but floods the path used by residents to reach the nearest bus, and the permit treats that path as unofficial.

wd-p-0928|competition|realist,adventure|A relay team discovers that its fastest runner has been hiding an injury by shortening the practiced handover. Keeping the change would shift the danger to the next runner during the race.

wd-p-0929|causality|speculative,mystery|A gardener grows plants that reveal the last place their seeds were carried. One points toward a building never constructed, and its supplier has already accepted payment for the next season's harvest there.

wd-p-0930|repair|realist,family|A family restores an old fishing boat for a celebration, then learns that its patched hull is the record of a rescue the owner has refused to describe. Replacing the wood would remove the remaining evidence of who was aboard.

wd-p-0931|coordination|realist,political|A town's new shared delivery scheme reduces traffic but requires every household to collect parcels from one hub. The residents producing the apparent savings are the ones now unable to reach their deliveries.

wd-p-0932|exchange|speculative,adventure|A trader buys a compass that points toward the nearest unpaid debt. During a desert crossing it leads away from water toward a person who owes the trader nothing but has been carrying someone else's obligation.

wd-p-0933|identity|realist,mystery|A sports referee recognizes a supposedly retired player competing under a legal new name. The player is eligible, but the old name appears on a disciplinary report that belongs to someone else.

wd-p-0934|learning|realist,romance|Two people join a language exchange to prepare for separate journeys. Their growing attachment depends on phrases practiced for departure, and neither knows how to change the lessons without admitting a changed destination.

wd-p-0935|resources|realist,adventure|An ecological survey team must transport live samples through a heat wave. Cooling the samples uses the vehicle's drinking-water reserve, and losing the samples would erase the only evidence supporting protection of the site.

wd-p-0936|interpretation|speculative,political|A town consults migrating birds to choose planting dates. A researcher discovers that the birds are responding to artificial lights, and turning the lights off would disrupt the night work that finances the harvest.

wd-p-0937|proof|mystery,realist|A sports journalist finds that a celebrated record used the correct distance on a course measured from the wrong starting line. The athlete wants correction, but the club has sold the record as proof of a training method.

wd-p-0938|access|realist,family|A community kitchen asks regular cooks to contribute a recipe. One cook can reproduce a dish only by touch and refuses a written approximation that would make her expertise appear less precise than everyone else's.

wd-p-0939|threshold|speculative,adventure|A rescue team enters a habitat where every opened door seals the previous one. The route remains safe until a stretcher cannot turn through the final angle and returning would require reopening a door behind them.

wd-p-0940|recognition|realist,political|A city honors a gardener for beautifying an empty lot. The gardener has been preserving traces of homes demolished there, and accepting the award's wording would endorse the claim that the land had no important use before the flowers.

wd-p-0941|choice|realist,romance|A couple plans to learn a new skill together and independently signs up for the same course. Both had chosen it as a private escape from being part of a pair, leaving coincidence to look like perfect compatibility.

wd-p-0942|maintenance|speculative,mystery|A town's public fountain repeats the last truthful sentence spoken beside it. Its caretaker hears a sentence in her own voice that she has never said, and the maintenance schedule shows someone replaced its basin during her absence.

wd-p-0943|competition|realist,family|An adult sibling coaches a younger adult for a contest they once lost. The trainee develops a method the coach was told was unacceptable, and supporting it requires challenging the judgment around which the coach built an identity.

wd-p-0944|route|realist,adventure|A migrating beekeeping crew finds its planned stopping site treated with a chemical not listed in the notice. Moving the hives saves them but would place the bees beyond range of orchards depending on their arrival.

wd-p-0945|consent|realist,political|A documentary about a community garden uses a participant's joyful interview to support its relocation. The participant agreed to be filmed but opposed the move, and the director argues that every quoted sentence remains accurate.

wd-p-0946|sequence|mystery,realist|A race official finds that finish-line photographs were numbered in the order uploaded rather than exposed. The mistaken sequence changes the winner, but the original times also reveal an unreported interruption that affected everyone differently.

wd-p-0947|care|speculative,family|A household tree sheds a leaf whenever someone gives comfort they do not feel able to sustain. Its sudden bareness forces the family to ask which reassuring promises were made without enough help behind them.

wd-p-0948|resources|realist,political|A coastal town replaces public taps with efficient refill stations requiring reusable containers. The people most dependent on free water have nowhere to clean the containers, a need the savings calculation never included.

wd-p-0949|proof|mystery,adventure|An explorer's photograph proves a route was open during a disputed journey. A botanist identifies a seasonal plant in the foreground, showing that the photograph was taken from a cultivated greenhouse rather than the supposed landscape.

wd-p-0950|identity|speculative,romance|Two people meet in a town where visitors are introduced by the task they most recently completed. One keeps postponing an ordinary chore because finishing it would replace the admired introduction that began their relationship.

wd-p-0951|craft|realist,family|A grandparent's seed collection produces unfamiliar vegetables. A grandchild learns that the labels name people who shared the seeds, not varieties, and preserving the collection requires rebuilding relationships rather than simply copying the names.

wd-p-0952|coordination|realist,adventure|A cycling race is rerouted after a storm, but support vehicles receive the revised map before riders do. A mechanic must choose between following the official convoy and waiting at the old route for riders the timing system no longer tracks.

wd-p-0953|scarcity|speculative,political|A community's rainmaker can guarantee rain only by naming who may not use it. A drought reveals that the apparently harmless exclusions have accumulated into a group whose crops have never received protection.

wd-p-0954|observation|mystery,realist|A park ranger finds footprints leading into a fenced restoration plot without any return marks. The visitor left using the workers' temporary boards, and only someone with the revised work schedule would know when they were laid.

wd-p-0955|permission|realist,romance|A person invites a partner to make changes in a shared garden, then discovers that the removed plants marked anniversaries never explained aloud. Undoing the changes would require admitting that the apparent permission lacked essential context.

wd-p-0956|status|realist,satire|A town labels a neglected green space wild to avoid maintaining it. When volunteers document its valuable habitat, officials seek an award for deliberate ecological management and ask the volunteers to endorse the description.

wd-p-0957|threshold|speculative,adventure|A storm refuge admits everyone who arrives before the first thunder. A guide hears thunder through a communication relay before it reaches the refuge, and the keeper must decide which arrival counts as the storm's beginning.

wd-p-0958|learning|realist,family|A teenager asks an older relative to teach a card game and wins using a strategy the family calls rude. Explaining the rule reveals that politeness has protected one respected player's habit of controlling every round.

wd-p-0959|exchange|realist,political|An orchard shares fruit with residents who help harvest. A resident unable to climb or carry has been recording yields for years, but the new exchange rule counts only work visible on the harvest day.

wd-p-0960|interpretation|speculative,mystery|A map of animal tracks shows a repeated route through a wall. The investigator discovers that the wall is newer than the map, while the tracks are being renewed by an animal that remembers the old passage.

wd-p-0961|choice|realist,romance|Two partners volunteer for a long restoration project, each believing it will give the other a reason to remain nearby. A finished phase removes their practical excuse for meeting, and neither has practiced making a direct invitation.

wd-p-0962|repair|realist,adventure|A conservation crew can stabilize an eroding bank using branches from a nesting tree. Waiting protects the nest but risks losing the river crossing needed to deliver supplies for the next stage of restoration.

wd-p-0963|proof|mystery,realist|A plant breeder recognizes an unauthorized variety in a prize-winning garden. The gardener received it as a gift, and proving its origin would reveal that the breeder's own assistant shared it to prevent its destruction.

wd-p-0964|access|realist,political|A city creates a permit for gathering fallen fruit on public land. The permit map omits trees planted by residents without permission, turning the most accessible harvest into the only one legally unavailable.

wd-p-0965|recognition|speculative,family|A family keeps a stone that warms when someone returns willingly. It remains cold during a celebrated homecoming because the returning person came to fulfill an obligation nobody has acknowledged asking them to carry.

wd-p-0966|coordination|realist,adventure|A river cleanup uncovers a cable maintaining a temporary flood alarm. Removing it would satisfy the cleanup plan, while leaving it requires acknowledging an improvised safety system the authorities have never inspected.

wd-p-0967|scarcity|realist,romance|A couple shares one inexpensive studio session each week. When both receive urgent opportunities needing the same time, choosing who uses it reveals that their arrangement never distinguished mutual support from taking turns.

wd-p-0968|identity|mystery,family|A family cookbook contains one recipe in a handwriting no relative recognizes. A former neighbor identifies it as the hand of the person the family remembers only as a customer, not the collaborator who kept the business open.

wd-p-0969|maintenance|speculative,political|A town's public trees retain shade only while residents care for them collectively. Privatizing maintenance produces healthier individual trees but breaks the shared canopy people relied on to cross the town safely.

wd-p-0970|route|realist,adventure|A guide leading a nocturnal wildlife survey loses the visual route markers installed earlier. The markers were removed by volunteers protecting the same wildlife from disturbance, and both teams have been following valid but uncoordinated instructions.

wd-p-0971|consent|realist,family|A child donates a treasured collection to a local exhibition, then wants it returned early. The family praises the generosity while treating the request as selfishness, forcing the curator to decide whether a child's gift can still be reconsidered.

wd-p-0972|measurement|mystery,realist|An orchard's harvest records show an impossible improvement after new trees were planted. The total includes fruit supplied by neighboring growers, making the successful trial a record of cooperation disguised as a technical breakthrough.

wd-p-0973|choice|speculative,romance|A garden lets each partner grow one scene from a possible shared future. The scenes look incompatible until they realize that both selected what they thought the other wanted rather than what they hoped for themselves.

wd-p-0974|craft|realist,family|A family teaches a child to prepare a ceremonial food while insisting that measurements are unnecessary. The child needs written steps to learn confidently, and the request is mistaken for doubting a knowledge transmitted through practice.

wd-p-0975|resources|realist,political|A town converts an unused sports ground into allotments. The ground was unused only because its gate had been locked, and the former players must prove demand without an accessible place to demonstrate it.

wd-p-0976|observation|speculative,mystery|A greenhouse's glass shows the weather at the place where each pane was made. One pane begins showing an indoor room, suggesting that its original landscape has been enclosed around someone still maintaining the glassworks.

wd-p-0977|repair|realist,adventure|A rowing crew discovers that a damaged oar can be shortened into a usable paddle. The change makes the boat maneuverable but invalidates the steering pattern the least experienced crew member has practiced for the approaching rapids.

wd-p-0978|permission|realist,romance|A couple agrees that either may invite friends to their shared workspace. A guest begins helping with a project, and the invitation unexpectedly becomes a collaboration neither partner knows how to limit without seeming unwelcoming.

wd-p-0979|status|realist,satire|A community competition rewards the most self-sufficient household. The leading entrant's detailed records reveal extensive exchanges with neighbors, and the judges must decide whether admitting interdependence makes the household less successful or the competition's definition wrong.

wd-p-0980|threshold|speculative,adventure|A protective orchard closes its paths when the last fruit is picked. A traveler harvests the final branch to feed a companion without knowing that another group is still inside searching for the exit.

wd-p-0981|learning|realist,family|An adult learns a family's fishing method and discovers that its celebrated secret is an adjustment for a relative's old injury. Teaching the method publicly would honor ingenuity while exposing a limitation kept private for decades.

wd-p-0982|exchange|realist,political|A volunteer garden offers plots according to hours previously contributed. New residents can contribute only after receiving a plot, and the coordinator must change a rule that existing gardeners regard as proof of earned fairness.

wd-p-0983|interpretation|mystery,realist|A handwritten trail note warns against the safest-looking route. The unfamiliar symbol means fallen timber in one local guidebook and a cleared passage in another, both written by people with good reasons to trust their own version.

wd-p-0984|recognition|realist,romance|A person returns to a place a partner once described as beautiful and finds it ordinary. Asking what made it special reveals that the admired scene depended on a person the partner has never mentioned.

wd-p-0985|coordination|speculative,political|A valley's crops ripen when its villages sing together. A broadcast makes coordination easy, but replacing local songs with one central version excludes the village whose timing kept everyone safe from late frost.

wd-p-0986|scarcity|realist,adventure|A survey team has enough cooling packs for fragile samples or a participant's temperature-sensitive medicine. The sample schedule concealed the medicine's need because the participant feared being removed from the expedition.

wd-p-0987|identity|speculative,family|A town assigns each child a tree that grows according to public expectations of them. An adult cuts down her stunted tree, and the family must decide whether to mourn the symbol or support the life no longer measured by it.

wd-p-0988|maintenance|realist,political|A restored public pond begins leaking into nearby cellars. The volunteers can seal it, but doing so requires reopening a buried drain that residents blocked to keep pollutants from an upstream business out of the water.

wd-p-0989|route|realist,adventure|A search dog follows a missing person's scent to a bag of borrowed clothes. The trainer must reconstruct who wore which layer during a cold night rather than assume the strongest scent marks the person's latest route.

wd-p-0990|consent|realist,romance|A person commissions a garden for a partner using private messages as the design brief. The designer's public explanation would turn intimate words into a promotional story before the partner has seen the gift.

wd-p-0991|measurement|speculative,mystery|A weather vane points toward the person who last changed a local forecast. It repeatedly indicates an ordinary gardener whose small irrigation choices alter the conditions used by the town's official prediction system.

wd-p-0992|choice|realist,family|A family wants to replace a failing fruit tree with the same variety. A child asks for a different tree better suited to the changing climate, making continuity depend on whether resemblance or continued use matters more.

wd-p-0993|craft|realist,adventure|A rope team uses a traditional splice to repair a safety line. The replacement fiber stretches differently from the old material, and the person advocating adaptation must challenge the respected instructor who taught the original method.

wd-p-0994|resources|realist,political|A neighborhood installs communal charging points on the condition that everyone can supply their own cable. The organizer discovers that the most urgently needed equipment uses a connector too costly for its owners to obtain.

wd-p-0995|observation|mystery,realist|A gardener notices that flowers have been cut from every memorial except one. The untouched plot belongs to the person accused of taking them, but the cutting pattern follows an old watering route used by someone else.

wd-p-0996|repair|speculative,family|A family repairs a fence that keeps remembered animals inside a garden. Closing its last gap would stop the visits of a creature everyone remembers differently, forcing a decision about which version should be allowed to remain.

wd-p-0997|permission|realist,romance|A couple agrees to renovate an inherited shed together. One begins using it alone before the work is finished, revealing that the hoped-for shared project has become the private space the other thought they were building.

wd-p-0998|status|realist,satire|A town declares a new garden entirely volunteer-built while paying a contractor to prepare the hidden foundations. The contractor asks for a visible sign, and the organizer must decide whether the inspiring claim is worth preserving through an omission.

wd-p-0999|threshold|speculative,adventure|A rescue path through a living hedge opens only for groups traveling at the same pace. An injured traveler can continue only if everyone slows, while the pursuers gain ground at the speed the group could otherwise maintain.

wd-p-1000|learning|realist,family|A parent asks a child to record a grandparent's gardening advice. The grandparent keeps changing the instructions for different plants, and the child must decide whether a faithful record is a fixed recipe or a method for noticing differences.

wd-p-1001|exchange|realist,political|A market exchanges unsold produce at closing so nothing is wasted. A new trader begins overproducing to gain access to the exchange, and the organizer must protect mutual aid without punishing people whose surplus is accidental.
